## Findings
- Issue #5414 (http://.example.com -> UnicodeError): root cause is PreparedRequest.prepare_url in requests/models.py — its ASCII-host guard only rejected hosts starting with `*`, so a leading-dot host passed through and the UnicodeError surfaced later at connection time. Upstream fix (requests 2.34.2, models.py:531) rejects hosts starting with `*` OR `.`.
- Fix applied (1 line, models.py:406): `elif host.startswith((u'*', u'.')):` — matches upstream exactly.
- Verified: prepare_url('http://.example.com') and requests.get('http://.example.com') now raise InvalidURL('URL has an invalid label.'); normal URLs, wildcard hosts, IDNA hosts, 'http://' all behave as before.
- Test suite: baseline (stashed fix) == post-fix: 18 failed / 362 passed / 176 errors — the errors are network-blocked httpbin fixtures (www.python.org, httpbin.org refused in this env), not caused by the change. test_preparing_bad_url: 5/5 pass.
- Env note: the campaign venv's site-packages requests (2.34.2) shadows the local checkout unless cwd is on sys.path; project root is C:/Users/agent/work/work/requests-5414-panel.
